LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_RetributionGunlance.label: (Raven) Retribution Gunlance
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_RetributionGunlance.descrip: A uniquely designed special weapon resembling an ancient gunlance. It can fire lethal golden explosive rounds from a distance, while its sharp and heavy blade can easily tear through enemy armor in close combat. It is a fierce weapon that dominates at both long and short ranges.
